QatarEnergy NFE LNG, Ras Laffan Mega-Train, and the Cryogenic-PAUT Specialisation

QatarEnergy North Field Expansion (NFE) is the largest single LNG capex program globally — Ras Laffan trains 7-12 + downstream + helium recovery + ethane recovery — driving sustained cryogenic-service PAUT per ASME Section V Article 4 Mandatory Appendix VIII + ASTM E2491 inspector demand through 2026-2030. Cryogenic-service piping (austenitic 304L / 316L / 9% Ni steel cryogenic vessels) faces chloride SCC per API RP 571 §4.5.1 in any region where chlorides bridge ambient + cryogenic + ambient cycles, plus low-temperature embrittlement on ferritic transition welds. PAUT scan plans for cryogenic service require focal-law authorship that accounts for sound-velocity variation across austenitic grain coarsening — a calibration drill few foreign cohorts cover. Atlantis Doha + Dammam cohorts run cryogenic-service PAUT practical modules with QatarEnergy + JGC + Chiyoda + Hyundai E&C + Tecnimont engagement references. ISO 9712:2022 dual-stamp alongside ASNT is the preferred profile — QatarEnergy specifications accept both but operator preference leans ISO 9712 for cryogenic.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Does Aramco require CP-189 or is SNT-TC-1A enough?

A: Aramco SAEP-1112 §6.2.3 accepts SNT-TC-1A 2024 Level II for routine inspection; CP-189 Level II is preferred and is required for SAES-A-004 §4.2 critical-service piping.

Q2: How long do GCC cohorts run?

A: 5-day intensives for single-method Level II classroom + practical, with experience-hour logging continuing on-job. Multi-method cohorts run 2-3 weeks back-to-back.

Q3: Can I do Level III in the Middle East or do I need to fly to Houston?

A: Atlantis Academy runs Level III cohorts in Dammam, Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Doha, and Kuwait City quarterly. Houston + Hyderabad cohorts are alternates.

Q4: Pricing?

Q6: Visa support for cohort attendance?

A: Atlantis issues training-invitation letters that support Saudi business visa, UAE training visa, and Qatar / Kuwait / Bahrain / Oman equivalents. We do not sponsor work visas.

Q7: What about online cohorts?
